sentences.en: Bad weather upset our plans to go on a hike.
sentences.zh: 糟糕的天气打乱了我们徒步旅行的计划。

sentences.en: If I were healthy, I could go on a hike.
sentences.zh: 要是我身体好点的话，我可以去徒步。

sentences.en: The union bosses are fighting the freeze on wage hikes.
sentences.zh: 工会领导人在抵制工资猛增。

senses.zh: 远足，徒步旅行；（价格等）大幅上升，猛涨
